purpose: Four justified multi-line paragraphs: interword stretch, hyphenation, paragraph skip accumulation.
flashtex_features: greedy ragged-right breaking (no justification, no hyphenation)
notes: Isolates justification from everything else; compare with 02-wrapping-paragraph (two paragraphs).
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
